regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focus on high sensitivity with moderate speed by using longer seeds and lower cap values, while enabling frc and early_exit for efficiency.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Balance speed and accuracy by reducing the number of seeds with higher cap and using shorter seeds, while disabling frc to save computation.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Optimize for speed with very short seeds and high cap values, while using prechain filters to reduce unnecessary chain extensions and disable frc.
